_doc: User-editable settings. Copy this file to config.json and fill in your keys. The app NEVER writes back to config.json — your last-opened directory and file are tracked separately in state.json. Env-var substitution: "${MINIMAX_API_KEY}" reads from os.environ.

ai._doc: Set 'active' (text provider) and optionally 'tts_provider' (defaults to active if it supports TTS). Remove this whole 'ai' block to disable AI entirely.

minimax_anthropic._doc: Minimax via Anthropic-compatible Messages API. Supports M3 / M2.7 / M2.7-highspeed / M2.5 / M2.5-highspeed / M2.1 / M2.1-highspeed / M2. Best for text chat.

minimax._doc: Minimax via the native v2 API. Used for TTS and vision (the Anthropic-compatible endpoint above does not expose those).

mimo._doc: 小米 MiMo TTS（v2.5）。两个接入入口：(a) 普通 API base_url=https://api.xiaomimimo.com/v1 + 用 OpenAI SDK 风格 Bearer 鉴权；(b) TokenPlan 包月 base_url=https://token-plan-cn.xiaomimimo.com/v1 + api-key 头。本代码两个鉴权头都发，自动兼容。模型：mimo-v2.5-tts / -voicedesign / -voiceclone。
